LanguageData.HH.Bank.Building.DirectDepositDesc: On: the tills of your businesses are emptied into your bank account at midnight. Off: the takings are put down as silver next to the safe.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Building.NoAccount: No account yet. Open one here or at a comms console.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Building.SafeDirect: Takings go straight to the account at midnight.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Building.SafeFloor: Takings are put down as silver at midnight.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Building.SafeNoAccount: No bank account: takings are put down as silver at midnight.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Choose.Intro: Moving the account costs {0} silver, taken from the account. Loans stay with the bank that made them.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Choose.Title: Change banks
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Comm.Info: Banking, loans and the occasional dry remark.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Header.TierTip: Net worth = account + silver at home − debts: {0} silver. The tier only changes after a new value has held for a whole day. It sets the colony mood from this bank (setting: bank.moodOn).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Hist.TotalFeesTip: All fees, late fees and the price of changing banks.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Hist.TotalInterestTip: Everything the bank has paid you in interest (negative interest counted against it).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Letter.Bailout: {0} has decided that you are, in fact, too big to fail, and has rescued you with an interest-free loan of {1} silver. It runs for 60 days. This is a loan, not a gift. Nobody ever reads that part.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Letter.Late:
Dear customer,
loan {0} is now several days behind. A late fee has been added and your credit score has taken a small, unavoidable dent. The amount due is {1} silver.
The tone of these letters will change.
Clerk Ottoline
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Letter.Offset: Until loan {0} is settled, half of every deposit that reaches your account is applied to the debt, and no new loans are available. This is the part of the contract nobody remembers signing.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Letter.Seized: A clerk from {0} regrets to inform you that {1} silver of your balance has been "reallocated for administrative reasons". There is no appeal form. There is, however, a very nice pen.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Letter.Visit: Two representatives of Rim Recovery Partners have arrived. They are wearing bowler hats. They have no weapons and no appointment. They will stand near your door, quite calmly, until loan {0} is paid. They never attack, and they leave the moment the money does.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Loans.LimitTip: 0.15 × wealth × (score − 300) / 550, where wealth = net worth + a quarter of the colony wealth. At least the starter credit ({0} silver) for a fine score.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Loans.None: No loans. Ottoline is almost disappointed.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Loans.Quote: {0} silver at {1} % a year: {2} every {3} days, {4} in total ({5} interest).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Loans.RateTip: Base rate max(2 %, M − 1) = {0} % plus the spread of your bank ({1} points). It follows the profitability slider, so borrowing to invest never has a positive expectation.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Loans.ScoreTip: 300 to 850, starts at 600. On-time instalment +4, every late day -6, default -120, using more than 70 % of the limit -20, plus 20 × log10(wealth / 10,000). Base score {0}.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.BalanceTip: Exact: {0} silver. Interest every day: balance × (M^({1} × {2} / 60) − 1), with M = {3} per game year (the profitability slider). That is {4:0.##} % a day.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.CashTip: Silver lying around on your home maps.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.DebtTip: Sum of your open loans including accrued interest.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.DirectTip: Tills of your businesses are emptied into the account at midnight, minus {0} %.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.InterestTip: Interest paid on the balance since the quadrum began (15 days).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.NetTip: Account + silver at home − debts. Sets your wealth tier.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.Nothing: Nothing yet. A deposit would be a fine start.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.TransitTip: Silver that has left your storage but is not credited yet (deposit delay without a branch or ATM).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Lobby.WdInstant: cash at the building at once
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Msg.DepositArrived: {0} silver was credited to your account.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Msg.Missed: The instalment of loan {0} could not be paid.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Msg.PodsComing: {0} silver is on its way down in drop pods.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Msg.Settled: Loan {0} is back in good standing.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Open.Direct: Route till money straight to the bank at midnight
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Open.DirectTip: Takings of your shops, inn and casino go into the account instead of lying around as silver. You can switch this later at a night safe or in the settings (bank.directDeposit).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Open.Intro: Pick a bank. Opening an account is free; moving it later costs {0} silver. Until you have an account, nothing here bothers you, no letters, no mood, no fees.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Open.Title: Silverline: open an account
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.B: Please take a number. We have not had a number since the Third Collapse, but the gesture matters.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.C: Every coin here is accounted for. Mostly by me. At night.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.Collectors: My colleagues in the hats are not here for you. Do not look at them. They know.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.D: Mattresses are not a financial product. Though I hear they have a following.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.Debt: Debt is just savings from the future. The future is unusually keen to have them back.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.E: If anyone asks, the pen is not for sale.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.Empty: An empty account is just a very honest account.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.Huge: At this size we are no longer your bank. We are your climate.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.Interest: Interest this quadrum: {0}. That is, if I count correctly, some meals. Congratulations?
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.Overdue: We do not wish to alarm you. We have simply noticed that you have not noticed.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Quip.Rich: Four digits. Your hat is practically a top hat.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Raid.Bounty: {0} has sold the debt of loan {1} to people who do not send letters. There is a price on the head of your colony's leader.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Raid.Text: Rim Recovery Partners has run out of patience with loan {0}. Their agents are coming for valuables worth more than the debt. They will take what they can carry and go.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Raid.Title: Collection raid
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.Arrears: You are behind on a payment. Nobody lends to you until that is settled.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.AtmLimit: The ATM will only hand out {0} more today.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.BankUnavailable: That bank is not open to you.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.Funds: The account does not cover {0} plus {1} in fees.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.LoansResearch: Loans need the research project "consumer credit".
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.NoCredit: Your credit limit is used up ({0} silver left).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.NoSilver: Not enough silver in storage or at the trade beacon ({0} available).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.OverLimit: That is more than the {0} silver you may still borrow.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.SwitchFunds: Moving the account costs {0} silver and the account does not hold that.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Reason.Title: {0} only lends to holders of a royal title.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Seizure.Done: The team loaded up {0} silver worth of your belongings ({1}) and left, whistling. The debt is {2}.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Seizure.Refused: The recovery team politely stops being polite.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Seizure.Text: A seizure team from Rim Recovery Partners is at the door with a court order that appears to be a laminated napkin. They want valuables worth about {0} silver (120 % of loan {1}). Let them take it, and the loan is gone. Refuse, and they will take it the hard way.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Seizure.Title: Seizure notice
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Terms.AnchorsHead: M per year / highest collection stage
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Terms.AutoTip: Follow the difficulty slider again ({0} on your current difficulty).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Terms.DailyTip: M^(1/60) − 1. A game year has 60 days.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Terms.FeesNote: All fees scale with the "bank fee level" setting ({0} %).
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Terms.Preview: 1,000 silver at the index become {0} after one game year and {1} after ten.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Terms.ProfitIntro: How much invested money grows on average per game year (60 days). 1.0 is plus/minus nothing, 1.2 is +20 % a year. It also sets what loans cost. This is a setting of this save game.
LanguageData.HH.Bank.Terms.StageNote: Collection ladder: 1 reminder, 2 late fee, 3 offset against deposits, 4 friendly visit, 5 seizure team, 6 collection raid, 7 bounty. Now: stops at stage {0}.
